verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for an email SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only conventional analytics (open/click/bounce tracking, DMARC report analysis) and a way to connect MailerSend to external AI tools like Claude or Gemini. That external connection is an adjacent integration, not AI-generated insights or suggestions produced inside the product, so nothing documents the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
